info.title: fal/crystal-upscaler
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "fal/crystal-upscaler", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Clarity AI's Crystal Upscaler on fal (clarityai/crystal-upscaler): upscale a single image, with a focus on faces, skin and eyes.

creativity.description: How much new detail the model may invent. 0 keeps closest to the input.

image_url.description: URL of the input image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, at most 100 MB).

output_format.description: Output image format: png or jpg.

scale_factor.description: Factor applied to each side of the input image. fal bills per output megapixel, so the price grows with the square of this value.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for Clarity AI's Crystal Upscaler on fal: the terminal `GET /proxy/fal/clarityai/crystal-upscaler/requests/{request_id}` queue RESULT document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is submit-and-poll on fal's queue — the submit answers a `FalQueueStatus` handle and the result route answers this document once the request is COMPLETED.
The upscaled image is at `images[].url`. `content_type`, `file_name`, `file_size`, `width` and `height` describe the same file. Each is optional and may be null, and fal sends `width` and `height` as null, so read the dimensions from the file itself.
COMFY ROUTER DOES NOT RUN THIS MODEL TODAY. The catalog lists `fal/crystal-upscaler` and `GET /v2/models/fal/crystal-upscaler/openapi.json` publishes this document, but the operation has no `routerresult/classification.go` row, so `POST /v2/models/fal/crystal-upscaler` is refused before dispatch. The model is reachable today by calling `POST /proxy/fal/clarityai/crystal-upscaler` and then `GET /proxy/fal/clarityai/crystal-upscaler/requests/{request_id}` directly, which is where this document comes from.

content_type.description: MIME type of the image file.

file_size.description: Size of the image file in bytes.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels. fal sends null.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels. fal sends null.

FalCrystalUpscalerResponse.description: Result of a completed Clarity AI Crystal Upscaler request.
